title: parsed_brief
description: Phase 1 LLM parse-only output. Core 4 PRD fields (capacity, budget, date, theme) plus optional festival hour window (festival_start, festival_end). The LLM never designs; this is its sole structured output, validated/retried against this contract.

festival_start.description: Festival opening time HH:MM (24h). If absent, defaults to 09:00.

festival_end.description: Festival closing time HH:MM (24h). If absent, defaults to 23:00.
